_comment: Copy this file somewhere local and private, then run: chmod 600 <file>
Do NOT commit a filled-in copy. Add it to .gitignore.
Each customer needs name, tenantId and clientId.
The secret is supplied one of two ways:
clientSecret            inline - simplest, but readable by any process running as you
tenantName, outputDirectory, includeConditionalAccess and jsonDepth are optional.
A value left out is treated as 'not set for this customer' rather than inherited
from the environment or from a previously selected customer.
tenantName overrides the folder name that would otherwise be read from Graph.
Leave it out unless the organisation display name in Entra is unhelpful.
jsonDepth has a working default of 20 and is only ever replaced, never cleared.
A certificate is an alternative to a secret: certificateThumbprint (CurrentUser
store) or certificatePath (+ optional certificatePassword) for a PFX file.
Defining either one wins over clientSecret/secretVault for that customer - the
script clears $ClientSecret when it does, so a secret left over from the
environment or a previous customer cannot silently shadow the certificate. That
clearing is intentional; it is not a bug if you spot it while reading the code.
